text:
Before: roast chicken pieces (~120 g with skin), a large plate of lo mein noodles (~300 g), orange juice (~200 g), and a chocolate bar (~40 g).

After: the chicken is gone, the juice is mostly still there (about 190 g left of ~200 g, so only a bit drunk), and the bar is eaten (wrapper open and empty). The noodles are about 60% left, so about 40% eaten (~120 g).

Energy:
- Chicken, 120 g with skin, about 200 kcal per 100 g, giving ~240 kcal. It may be only ~100 g of meat, so I estimate 220 kcal.
- Noodles, 120 g at about 150 kcal per 100 g, giving ~180 kcal.
- Bar, 40 g at ~200 kcal.
- Juice, about 10 g at 45 kcal per 100 g, giving ~5 kcal.

Total ≈ 220 + 180 + 200 + 5 = 605 kcal.
Mass ≈ 110 + 120 + 40 + 10 = 280 g.

{"kcal": 605, "mass_g": 280}
